# MindeesUI

> Universal React Native CLI + Expo component library with a deterministic Layout Intelligence Layer. Components introspect their children and auto-adjust spacing, sizing, alignment, accessibility roles, and styling — every rule documented and overridable. New Architecture only (Fabric + JSI + TurboModules + Bridgeless). iOS, Android, React Native Web. TypeScript strict, WCAG 2.2 AA, Reanimated v4 UI-thread animations, Unistyles v3 zero-re-render theming.

## Components

### Layout & Typography
- `Box`, `Stack`, `HStack`, `VStack`, `ZStack`, `Grid`, `Divider`, `Spacer`
- `SafeAreaView`, `ScreenWrapper`
- `Text`, `Heading`, `Caption`, `Label`, `Link`, `Code`, `Kbd`

### Forms & Inputs
- `FormField`, `Input`, `Textarea`, `PasswordInput`, `SearchInput`
- `Checkbox`, `CheckboxGroup`, `Radio`, `RadioGroup`, `Switch`

### Buttons & Overlays
- `Button`, `IconButton`, `FAB`, `ButtonGroup`
- `Modal`, `BottomSheet`, `Toast`, `Tooltip`, `Popover`, `Drawer`, `Alert`, `ActionSheet`

### Navigation
- `Tabs` + `Tab` + `TabList` + `TabPanel`
- `TopBar`, `Breadcrumb`, `Pagination`, `Stepper`

### Display & Data
- `Card`, `Avatar`, `AvatarGroup`, `Badge`, `Tag`, `Chip`
- `Image`, `List`, `ListItem`, `Accordion`
- `Progress`, `Skeleton`, `Spinner`, `Stat`, `Rating`, `Timeline`

### Specialised (gated optional peers, graceful fallback)
- `CodeBlock` (zero-deps), `ColorPicker` (zero-deps)
- `QRCode` (requires `react-native-qrcode-svg`)
- `Barcode` + `Camera` (requires `expo-camera`)
- `MapView` (requires `react-native-maps`)
- `SignaturePad` (requires `react-native-signature-canvas`)
- `WebView` (requires `react-native-webview`)

## Foundations & Helpers

- `Slot`, `tagComponent`, `describeChildren`, `flattenChildren`
- `resolveSizeProps`, `resolveGapRule`, `resolveGapToken`
- `ThemeProvider`, `useTheme`, `useTokens`, `useReduceMotion`
- `PortalProvider`, `Portal`, `ErrorBoundary`
- `configureUnistyles`, `createStyles`, `resolveResponsive`, `useResponsive`
- `useUniqueId`, `useFormFieldA11y`, `useAnnouncer`
